Description: This course introduces essential academic skills for university success, focusing on effective study habits, critical and creative thinking, academic communication, and the responsible use of AI. Students will explore three key areas: AI and academic integrity, thinking skills for the digital age, and learning and communication at university. The course emphasizes self-directed learning and helps students manage their study, time, and learning strategies effectively in both traditional and online settings.
NoCredit: 3
Pre-Requisite: None
Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 1 hour final exam + 104 hours self-study
StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time
- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Promptly access the FLM system at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn
for up-to-date course information.
Note: Progress marks:
- 01 Participation: 10%
- Project - Part 1: 10%
- Project - Parts 2 & 3: 2x20%
- 01 Quiz: 5%
- 01 Individual Progress Test: 10%
- 01 Final exam: 25%
Conditions to pass: Final exam >= 4
Grade Average >= 5/10
MinAvgMarkToPass: 5
CLO1: Understand concepts of university learning expectations and student responsibilities.
CLO2: Apply effective study and memory strategies.
CLO3: Identify test-taking strategies used in academic assessments.
CLO4: Plan academic goals and manage study time effectively.
CLO5: Implement strategies to manage academic stress and maintain well-being.
CLO6: Demonstrate effective communication in academic contexts.
CLO7: Utilize digital learning tools and online learning strategies.
CLO8: Practice responsible and ethical use of AI in academic work.
CLO9: Evaluate the credibility of academic information sources.
CLO10: Apply thinking skills to analyze learning problems using critical or creative approaches.
CLO11: Integrate academic skills in practical learning tasks or project work.
